patches.name: Camera Looks Backport
patches.description: Enables Google Pixel 11's 13 signature Camera Looks (Sauce & Tomte including Flat, Buffalo, Dijon) on Pixel 6 through Pixel 10, fixes Portrait Mode blur on all cameras, and resolves Pixel 10 photo saving.

compatiblePackages.name: Pixel Camera
compatiblePackages.description: Google Camera 11.1 with Look processing backport and bug fixes

patches.name: Bento HDR+ Highlight Recovery (Experimental)
patches.description: Unlocks Google's Bento HDR+ highlight recovery pipeline and configurable Max HDR Ratio AE override on Pixel 7 Pro and other Pixel devices, with in-app toggles in Advanced Settings and safe EdgeTPU bento_edamame isolation.

compatiblePackages.name: Pixel Camera
compatiblePackages.description: Experimental Bento HDR+ Highlight Recovery & Max HDR Ratio AE override

patches.name: Viewfinder Quick Access Controls
patches.description: Enables customizable Left/Right viewfinder quick-access shortcut slots, interactive 10-tick Brightness & Shadow slider with tap-focus guards, smooth shadow curve, and proper tone pipeline reset.

patches.name: 10x Viewfinder Quick Zoom
patches.description: Unlocks the discrete 10x quick zoom button across Photo and Night Sight modes on Pro and telephoto Pixel devices, dynamic 1x focal length cycling (1.0x -> 1.2x -> 1.5x), and persistence across launches.

compatiblePackages.name: Pixel Camera
compatiblePackages.description: 10x Viewfinder Quick Zoom button and 1x focal length cycling

patches.name: Pixel Camera Creator Suite
patches.description: Enables Teleprompter HUD (Biotite), Live Audio VU Meter (Mica), and Social Framing Guides (Slate).

patches.name: Pro Manual Controls
patches.description: Enables Pro Manual Controls (Manual Focus, Shutter Speed, ISO, 50MP resolution toggle on Pro Pixels including Pixel 7 Pro, Focus Peaking, and Live Badges).

patches.name: Permanent Portrait Mode Fix
patches.description: Fixes front camera total blur and rear camera flat/bokeh-less portraits by routing portrait processing to Google's pure-TFLite monocular depth pipeline across all cameras (including ksf.b routing).

compatiblePackages.name: Pixel Camera
compatiblePackages.description: Permanent Portrait Mode fix across front and rear cameras

patches.name: Pixel 10 Photo Saving Fix
patches.description: Resolves Pixel 10 & Pro 12MP photos not saving while preserving Eclipse AE on Pixel 6-9 (including Pixel 7 Pro).

compatiblePackages.name: Pixel Camera
compatiblePackages.description: Photo saving fix and timestamp sync

patches.name: AV1 Video Hardware Encoding
patches.description: Unlocks AV1 hardware video recording on Tensor G3+ devices (Pixel 8/9/10) while safely keeping it disabled on Tensor G1/G2 (Pixel 6/7/7 Pro).

compatiblePackages.name: Pixel Camera
compatiblePackages.description: AV1 hardware video encoding (Tensor G3+ gated)

patches.name: 4K 60 FPS 10-bit HDR & Log Video
patches.description: Unlocks 10-bit HDR (HLG10 / BT.2020) and Amethyst Log video recording with hardware-safe 60 FPS gating.

patches.name: Seamless Video Lens Switching & Zoom Smoothing
patches.description: Eliminates video lens switching stutter and digital zoom crawl with 1 Euro filter, spring dynamics, and standby sensor pre-warming.

compatiblePackages.name: Pixel Camera

patches.name: Max Display Brightness

patches.name: Pro Image Quality & Denoise Tuning
patches.description: Adds in-app Camera Settings menus for JPEG Quality, Spatial Noise Reduction, Edge Sharpness, RAW DNG Format, Bento HDR+ Highlight Recovery, Max HDR Ratio, and opt-in Front Camera Backlight Fix.

compatiblePackages.name: Pixel Camera
